description: This script automates the process of generating and displaying pending Alembic database migration diffs without creating permanent revision files. It runs the 'alembic revision --autogenerate' command in a temporary environment, finds and displays the latest migration script, then cleans up to prevent pollution of migration history.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main function that creates a temporary directory, runs alembic autogeneration, finds the latest migration script, displays its content, and cleans up.
